doc.title: Introduction
doc.paragraph: The Administrative Guide is written for people who deploy and configure an application that uses Adaptive Framework.

Start with Installation, then Configuration, which describes the afw.conf file and the services it defines, and Deployment, which puts afwfcgi, a web server and the data together with containers or on a host. The Adapters, Indexes and Authorization chapters cover each part in detail. Tools describes the afw and afwfcgi commands, and the Appendix holds sample configuration files for Adaptive Framework, Nginx and systemd.
